name: Basil
description: A warm-season herb that is sensitive to frost. Great companion for tomatoes.
tips: Pinch off flower heads as they appear to encourage leafy growth. Harvest often.

careTasks.name: Begin hardening off seedlings
careTasks.description: Gradually expose seedlings to outdoor conditions over a week to prevent shock.

careTasks.name: Pinch back tips to encourage branching
careTasks.description: Pinch the growing tips to encourage the plant to become bushier and produce more leaves.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Basil consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.

name: Cilantro
description: A cool-season herb that bolts (goes to flower) very quickly in heat.
tips: Sow seeds every 2-3 weeks for a continuous supply. Harvest leaves often to delay bolting. The flowers are edible and attract beneficial insects.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting leaves
careTasks.description: Harvest your Cilantro when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Cilantro consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.

name: Parsley
description: A biennial herb grown as annual. Very slow to germinate from seed.
tips: Soak seeds overnight before planting to improve germination. Harvest outer stems regularly to encourage new growth.

careTasks.name: Begin hardening off seedlings
careTasks.description: Gradually expose seedlings to outdoor conditions over a week to prevent shock.

careTasks.name: Begin harvesting outer stems
careTasks.description: Harvest your Parsley when they reach a mature size and color. Regular harvesting can encourage more production.

careTasks.name: Watering
careTasks.description: Water your Parsley consistently. Provide about 1-2 inches of water per week, adjusting for rainfall.
